My dear [Emily](../persons.html#1012),
An odd question, but can you tell me what [Edward](../persons.html#1013) first taught himself on the violin? I want Lance Underwood to do it, and must mention some tune . . .

[^1]: Edith Emily Moberly (b.1839), third daughter of George Moberly.

[^2]: The date is implied by its position in Dulce Domum.
